name: Add AI Directory

sources.title: Homepage — live AI agents directory (100+ verified agents, new additions weekly)
Submit Your AI Agent — free editorial submission via prefilled email to info@addaidirectory.com

requirements: Product must be an AI agent — 'acts autonomously on a user's behalf' — with a clear practical use
Official public website that accurately explains the product
Currently available, in a documented waitlist/beta, or with a verifiable launch plan
Claims, pricing, ownership, and access requirements must be verifiable against reliable sources
No listing fee — 'no paid placement, no sponsored positions'; editorial merit only
preparation: Square product logo, min 200×200 px, PNG or SVG preferred (attach to the email — required)
Agent name, official website, one-sentence description, detailed overview
Primary category (Agent Tools, Data Science, Sales, Agentic Browsers, Audio, Content Creation, Defi, Finance, Image, No Code, SEO, Video)
Pricing model + verified starting price, availability status
Documentation, pricing, privacy policy, and terms URLs
Key features, known limitations, submitter name/work email/relationship to the product
workflow: Click 'Submit by Email' — opens a prefilled template to info@addaidirectory.com
Attach the square logo (and optional hero image) to the email
Fill every template field (agent details, access/pricing, official sources, editorial info, submitter)
Send; initial response targeted within 7 business days, full review may take longer
watchFor: Email-only submission — no web form; forgetting the logo attachment stalls the listing
Editors may rewrite, shorten, verify, or reject; submission wording is a starting point, not the final copy
Repeat submissions do not accelerate review
Do not send passwords, API keys, or confidential data — use a dedicated test account if offering review access
Corrections require official-source evidence; providers cannot pay to soften accurate limitations
countsAsLive: The agent appears on an addaidirectory.com/agents/<slug> page inside its primary category
unknowns: Whether non-agent AI tools (pure copilots/utilities) are accepted — eligibility says 'AI agent' specifically
Exact total review duration beyond the 7-business-day initial response
